email.subject1: a signal play for your team
email.body1:
Steve, saw the UND Foundation just posted a record $119.95M year and relaunched Forever UND with a $625M goal.

A bigger campaign target usually means more donor and partner accounts to engage than the team can personally cover, and that is where momentum leaks. Our AI worker researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so outreach coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more conversations per person.

I built a personalized signal play for your team off your activity and engagement signals, and prospects showing them tend to move about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Steve, quick follow-up on the Forever UND push.

With the goal raised to $625M, the activity target climbs faster than the team can ramp. Most teams cannot say how many qualified conversations they need to hit the number, so the gap shows up late and the campaign turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how much outreach your team needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add people.
email.body3:
Steve, last bit of proof for your team.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire fast enough. They ran our AI worker to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 qualified conversations in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every message auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your reply rate likely compares to peer development teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Steve, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling outreach without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters most right as a campaign relaunches, and I know running Forever UND at this scale is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-worker plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to your team either way.
